{
  "name": "cc-image-view",
  "description": "See the images you paste into Claude Code: thumbnails above the prompt instead of bare [Image #1] tags",
  "version": "0.3.2",
  "author": {
    "name": "gggodlin",
    "url": "https://github.com/GGGODLIN"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/GGGODLIN/cc-mod-image-view",
  "repository": "https://github.com/GGGODLIN/cc-mod-image-view",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "images",
    "paste",
    "preview",
    "thumbnails",
    "mod",
    "terminal",
    "claude-code"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "UI language. auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then LC_ALL / LANG, else English.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "en",
        "zh-TW"
      ]
    }
  }
}
